system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Water. 1 item slot (Worn, RIS Passive). Attunement.

Prerequisites: Prof[3]

This small, cursed pot acts both wards and haunts its user.

Cursed Pot Armor (Passive): This pot can only be worn by a Hulinari or Curiot, and acts as a Professional Leather Set. The first time in any combat that you would take damage, reduce that damage by 2X, where X is your Proficiency. However, if the combat is against undead, instead that Undead critically hits you.

Rulebook p.56.
